column1: # Swap table for the swingbridge-emulators-jgoodies-forms add-on. Guarded by PortedTypesTableTest — a class added
# here without a row (or without an entry on that test's SB-Emulators-invented list) fails the build.
# <upstream type>\t<this add-on's type>. Top-level public classes only; nested types rewrite off
# their enclosing type's row by longest-prefix match.
# Declared, not derived: this add-on REPLACES its upstream, so com.jgoodies.forms is on no
# classpath here to reflect over the way :emulators reflects over the JDK (M1D_addon_packaging's
# one-way direction). What the file therefore also makes visible is the fork's sparsity — upstream's
# heavily used builder package (PanelBuilder, ButtonBarBuilder, DefaultFormBuilder) has no rows
# because this add-on ships no builders, so the tool reports "no mapping" instead of the migrator
